name: webcam-pixel-grid
title: Webcam Pixel Grid
blurb: Webcam feed pixelated into a grid with motion-based 3D elevation.
description: Captures live webcam video, downsamples to a configurable grid, and renders each pixel as a 3D block elevated by detected motion. Supports monochrome and color modes.
use_when: Interactive webcam visualizations, portals, or immersive UI where motion detection adds depth.
avoid_when: Privacy-sensitive environments; requires persistent getUserMedia permission.
a11y: Requires explicit user permission to access camera. No interactive elements—visual effect only.
